comment: Replaces meridian_basin_direct.json (retired 2026-08-06, PLAN-metalstorm-wars.md §7.6). Meridian Basin's start positions sit in three disconnected components of the VEH/HEAVY passability mask, so its armies could never reach each other. Two humans, one per side. The scenario declares exactly two sides on teams 0 and 1, so there are no filler null-AI slots to materialise gap teams and no NPC team that would collide with Gaia's index. A copy of this file must also live in client/public/ — that, not manifests/, is what ?direct= fetches.
